{{Quote|Fight for Prince Lee-Char!|Nossor Ri betrays Riff Tamson|<ref name="P" />}}
'''Nossor Ri''' was a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] who conspired with the [[Karkarodon/Legends|Karkarodon]] [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]] to make the Quarren allies of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Nossor Ri later noticed his error, however, and rejoined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] after betraying Tamson and fighting [[Droid/Legends|droid]] forces with the aid of the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] warriors.

==Biography==
===Becoming a Separatist pawn===
{{Quote|Prince Lee-Char will bring the planet to ruin. The boy has neither the experience nor the knowledge to lead.|Nossor Ri expresses his views on Lee-Char becoming king|<ref name="Water War" />}}
[[File:NossorRi-SWE.png|thumb|left|160px|Nossor Ri, a Separatist pawn]]
About [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Water War Date">{{TCWdates|401|archivedate=20140711175014|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20140711175014/http://www.starwars.com/news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-chronological-episodeorder}}</ref> after the mysterious [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[King/Legends|King]] [[Yos Kolina/Legends|Yos Kolina]], [[King of Mon Cala/Legends|leader of Mon Cala]], tensions began to grow between the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] and the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. [[Chief/Legends|chieftain]] Nossor Ri was the one leading [[Gender/Legends|his]] people at this [[Time/Legends|time]] of crisis. Backed by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and convinced by a Separatist [[Envoy/Legends|envoy]] by the name of [[Riff Tamson/Legends|Riff Tamson]], who was later be revealed as Kolina's murderer, Ri presented the claims of his people in front of the Mon Calamari Council in the [[Coral City/Legends|capital]]. Ri expressed the disagreement of the Quarren to elect Kolina's son, [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Lee-Char/Legends|Lee-Char]], as the next ruler of the [[Mon Calamari system/Legends|Calamari system]]. In the end Nossor Ri, Tamson, and the Quarren left the gathering disgruntled by the results of the peace talks. Before leaving, however, the chieftain approached Lee-Char, who by that point had lost all hope for peace, and Ri expressed his condolences and admiration for Lee-Char's father.<ref name="Water War" />

All the happenings were machinations by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] and Tamson to rip the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] from its alliance with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and bring it to the Separatist side of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], a series of battles between the Galactic Republic and the Confederacy of Independent Systems, also known as the Separatists. Ri had agreed to do so as he felt he was doing what was best for his people. Little did he know that Dooku and Tamson were planning to put all inhabitants of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] in chains and use them as [[Slavery/Legends|slaves]].<ref name="Water War" />

All the events led to the [[Battle of Mon Cala/Legends|Battle of Mon Cala]], in which Ri took part in and observed from a distance. During the initial attack, the Quarren and [[Aqua droid/Legends|Aqua droids]] retreated. Ri was puzzled by the situation as he had not anticipated the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] to be defeated by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Tamson then brought in the [[Hydroid Medusa/Legends|secret weapons]] that would win the battle.<ref name="Water War" />

The attack proceeded as planned and the opposing forces were driven into hiding. Although the Quarren were supposed to be part of the last push against the Jedi and the Mon Calamari, Ri decided to hold off his forces as he allegedly felt that Tamson was certain to win. This attitude and disobedience by the chieftain angered the [[Karkarodon/Legends|Karkarodon]]. Grabbing the Quarren by his tentacled face, Tamson threatened to kill Ri if he did not follow orders again.<ref name="Water War" />

===Search for Lee-Char===
{{Quote|Excuse me, Count Dooku, but what of the prisoners?|Nossor Ri inquiring of the fates of their captured enemies|<ref name="Gungan Attack">{{TCW|Gungan Attack}}</ref>}}
After the initial victory, Ri and Tamson situated themselves at the Central palace of the Mon Calamari [[Capital/Legends|capital]]. From there they monitored the situation and began the search for Lee-Char and his allies. Dooku contacted the victors and insisted they press on and take full control of the planet. During the conversation, Ri spoke with concern for the captured Mon Calamari and wished to know if the women and children would be spared the fate of a slave. A furious Dooku silenced the Quarren leader and insisted all Mon Calamari be sent to work as slaves. This was the first sign that Ri saw of the Confederacy's ruthless policy towards [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] of war and started to have doubts about his decision to join the Separatists.<ref name="Water War" />

[[File:TCW_Water_War_Quarren_warriors.png|thumb|right|300px|Nossor Ri with a group of Quarren Warriors]]
When the Jedi and Mon Calamari [[Troop/Legends|troops]] attempted to escape to the [[Consular-class cruiser (Charger c70 retrofit)/Legends|Republic ship]] on the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] surface, Ri was contacted by the one of [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] that engaged the enemy forces. Tamson pushed Ri aside and ordered the Quarren to allow the Jedi and Prince to get to the ship. Soon after, he sprung the trap and the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was destroyed in front of the [[Eye/Legends|eyes]] of the Prince in order to make him lose all hope of escape.<ref name="Water War" />

Shortly after, the Jedi disrupted the Separatist communications by destroying a [[Mon Cala central planetary scanner mast/Legends|building]] that housed Dac's Inner-planetary scanners; this was reported to Ri and Tamson. Ri pointed out that there was nothing on the scope prior to this. However, Tamson predicted an attack to happen in the near future and warned the chieftain that another battle would arrive. As expected, a huge force containing mostly [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] warriors soon made their way to the droid forces. The Prince himself then began to free prisoners, while a large attack force engaged the droid forces at the site of the destroyed scanners. Ri was left alone at the Palace as Tamson went in search of the Prince.<ref name="Gungan Attack" />

Ri was informed of both attacks and contacted Tamson to report on the situation. The Quarren leader proposed a retreat of all [[Confederacy military/Legends|Separatist forces]], but Tamson decided to send [[Trident-class assault ship/Legends|''Trident''-class assault ships]] to both locations, while he also joined the battle in which the Prince was present, so he could finish him off once and for all.<ref name="Gungan Attack" />

===Uniting with the Mon Calamari===
{{Quote|As representative of the Quarren people, I pledge our loyalty to you.|Nossor Ri confirming his loyalty to King Lee-Char|<ref name="P" />}}
[[File:LeeCharCrowned-Prisoners.jpg|thumb|left|300px|Nossor Ri at Lee Char's crowning]]
After Tamson received news that the Prince was captured, Ri was shocked to learn that Tamson was taking the [[Throne/Legends|throne]] instead of the Quarren. He finally came to realize that serving the Confederacy was his true mistake, and that the Quarren were used ever since Tamson murdered the King. Ri was then requested by Lee-Char to turn on his Separatist allies and help Lee-Char drive them from Mon Calmarai. Ri refused until a few moments before Lee-Char was about to be executed. Ri could not allow the young prince to die for everything he had done, so he immediately ordered the Quarren to join Lee-Char and the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic forces]] to defeat the Separatists. Ri was able to save the prince's life, and a battle ensued. After the battle was won for the Mon Calamari and the Quarren, they were finally united, and the Quarren once again became allies of the Galactic Republic. Ri was later present when the Prince became the King of Dac.<ref name="P" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Your father was my trusted friend. I am sorry for your loss.|Nossor Ri acknowledging his friendship with Lee-Char's father|<ref name="Water War" />}}
An outspoken representative of the Quarren, Nossor Ri seemed disgruntled and thought it unfair that the Mon Calamari ruled over both the Quarren and their own kind. This led him to side with a Separatist envoy, and was initially very easy to manipulate.<ref name="Water War" /> Later on, after witnessing the true, ruthless personalities of the people he had aligned himself with, Ri betrayed the Separatists, and sided with the Mon Calamari, uniting all people of Mon Cala once again, and bringing the Quarren back to the Galactic Republic.<ref name="P" />

Nossor Ri had [[Color/Legends|salmon-colored]] skin,<ref name="Water War" /> and blue eyes. He stood at 1.92 [[Meter/Legends|meters]],<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> and often wore black [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] specially designed for [[Water/Legends|underwater]] living.<ref name="Water War" />

==Equipment==
{{Quote|The day is won.|Nossor Ri, informing his allies of Lee-Char's victory while raising a blaster rifle in triumph|<ref name="P" />}}
Being the representative of the Quarren, Ri was rarely seen carrying a weapon of any sort. However, during the Battle of Mon Cala, Ri wielded a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]].<ref name="P" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nossor Ri first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series episode, [[Water War]], which was released in [[2011]]. He was voiced by [[Corey Burton]].<ref name="Water War" />

There was a story arc planned for a season after [[The Clone Wars: The Lost Missions]]. In it, [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] would return to Dac, where they would learn that Nossor Ri had been murdered. Another Quarren, [[Tikkes/Legends|Tikkes]], would temporarily assume the role of Leader of the Quarren, while [[Tundra Dowmeia/Legends|Tundra Dowmeia]] would also make an appearance.<ref name="The Clone Wars: Declassified">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars – The Lost Missions|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' – The Lost Missions]], Declassified Featurette</ref>
